messages:
ella.marketing: Quick ask 10 Need a small, modular benchmark asset pack for launch + webinar: hero, social tiles, email header, and a tiny inbound-routing diagram. Single Figma library with toggles for metrics and copy variants.

rene.design: One Figma master with component variants OK. Any size constraints?

ella.marketing: Hero needs to be safe for 16:9 and 4:3 crops. Social tiles must be legible at 120px width. Exports: hero 1200x628 PNG, social 1080x1080 PNG + 600x600 JPG fallback, email 600x200 PNG, diagram SVG. Filename pattern: launchbench_{variant}_{locale}.png

troy.content: Ill draft two headline families (outcome vs product). Outcome for hero.

anya.brand: Brand notes: use primary gradient, avoid full-bleed secondary blue. Inter var weights 400/600 only. Ensure AA contrast.

opsbot: Add export size cap: social PNGs <=200KB; create JPG fallback if larger. Include metadata CSV listing filename, variant, locale.

legalbot: Reminder: no customer PII or identifiable metrics in public assets. Mark sample numbers anonymized.

rene.design: Uploading first-pass Figma by tomorrow 10am PST. Will add token placeholders like {{model}}, {{p50_latency_ms}}.

ella.marketing: Great. Ill attach CSV metrics and deck snippets after standup. Please drop final export links here when ready. :rocket:
